primary.title: Ninety-five Theses
primary.author: Martin Luther
primary.rationale: The foundational document of the Protestant Reformation, widely available in translation.

primary.title: On the Freedom of a Christian
primary.author: Martin Luther
primary.rationale: A key theological treatise outlining Luther's core beliefs on faith and Christian liberty.

primary.title: Table Talk
primary.author: Martin Luther
primary.rationale: A collection of Luther's reported conversations and sayings, offering insights into his personal views and daily life. Published posthumously.

secondary.title: Martin Luther: A Life
secondary.author: James M. Kittelson
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and well-regarded scholarly biography of Martin Luther.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Martin Luther
secondary.author: Donald K. McKim
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Luther's life, theology, and impact.

secondary.title: Luther's Last Battle: The Struggle for the German Reformation
secondary.author: Mark U. Edwards Jr.
secondary.rationale: Focuses on the later years of Luther's life and his role in shaping the Reformation's trajectory.

suggestions.notes: Primary source texts are often available in collected works or specific translations. Secondary sources are chosen for their scholarly reputation and recency.
